data: For fiscal 2025, Amazon reported total net sales of $716,924 million (about $716.9 billion) for the year ended December 31, 2025, while Apple reported net sales of $416,161 million (about $416.2 billion) for the fiscal year ended September 27, 2025. Amazon's revenue was therefore about 1.72 times Apple's, a gap of roughly $300.8 billion. The fiscal years do not line up exactly: Amazon's follows the calendar year, while Apple's ends in late September, so the two periods overlap by about nine months. Amazon's revenue grew 12.4% from $637,959 million in fiscal 2024, and Apple's grew 6.4% from $391,035 million.
